verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs say Trigger and SLO burn alerts can be routed to a custom webhook that receives JSON payloads, which any service can consume. Payloads can be customized with dynamic variables and Go template functions, which makes them practical inputs for automated remediation or agent endpoints. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook-driven remediation or agent triggering, and no documented example targeting an agent or remediation system specifically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents

citations.quote: Route Honeycomb Trigger and SLO burn alerts to any service that accepts a JSON payload, including third-party tools and custom integrations.
This allows you to build custom integrations that receive JSON payloads from Honeycomb upon alerts firing.
route notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or a custom webhook
Customize Honeycomb webhook payloads with dynamic variables that populate alert context for precise, actionable notifications.
Transform JSON template data in your Honeycomb webhook payloads using Go template functions to format, filter, and restructure alert content before delivery.
